intent: Dark, monochrome developer-tool hero: headline lines blur in, then a terminal assembles and an AI agent plans, writes files, passes tests and opens a PR on a loop.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useMotionValue, useTransform, useSpring, animate, AnimatePresence)

layout.grid: @container root; 12 cols from @5xl (64rem): copy 6, terminal 6; stacked below
layout.backdrop: 56px hairline grid at white/3%, radial mask centred behind the terminal
layout.terminal: tab bar 44px, body 380/440/480px scrolling internally, status bar 32px

headline.lines: one prop string per line; emphasis phrase at ink/45, no-wrap

color.accent: #d4ff3a via the accent prop, only on the install chip's Copied state
color.terminal: ticks, summary and PR marker in ink; spinners ink/50; +n ink/80; −n ink/40; tree glyphs ink/25

motion.copy: once at 20% in view: headline lines rise 12px from blur(8px), 550ms, 65ms apart; body 0.26s, actions 0.32s, facts from 0.38s 40ms apart
motion.terminal: own once trigger at 30%: frame rises 24px from blur(8px), 700ms at 0.3s; header hairline draws, pause/tab/+/clock land 40ms apart from 0.42s; tab highlight draws; status bar at 0.52s
motion.session: first line 800ms after the frame starts; one rAF clock in a motion value; React state only at timeline marks; pauses offscreen, in hidden tabs and while held; replays after loopPause
motion.rows: each new line fades up 4px from blur(3px), 220ms
motion.counts: files and +/− tween to each new value over 400ms, tabular
motion.tilt: up to 1.5° toward a mouse pointer, spring 180/22
motion.copy chip: icon pops on spring 500/30; Copied holds 1.8s
motion.reducedMotion: finished session at once, no loop, tilt or blink; one 150ms fade; counts set instantly

responsive.narrow: copy then terminal; actions full width below @md; tab subtitle and + hidden below @md

accessibility: pause button with aria-pressed and a label
copy chip with a descriptive aria-label and a polite live region
reduced motion shows the finished session
avoid: brand bar or release announcement inside the hero
lime, amber or green terminal colours
radial glow blobs, gradient edges, button glows
macOS traffic lights and hacker clichés
